summary: Security review cannot assess Sprint 4’s drag-and-drop implementation because it is absent; the existing protected PATCH endpoint remains the only task-movement path.

messages.content: Security review is blocked because no Sprint 4 drag-and-drop or optimistic-update code exists. When added, retain authenticated PATCH requests, treat client drop data as untrusted, and roll back optimistic state on failed API responses.

blockers: No drag-and-drop or optimistic-update implementation exists in the frontend to review.
decisions: Current status changes use the existing authenticated PATCH endpoint and retain server-side status validation.
A future optimistic implementation must restore the prior local task state if PATCH fails, preventing UI/server state divergence.
